label: copy-phase input v (rare, sparse subset)
explanation: Fires almost exclusively when the token v is fed back as input during the copy phase (85% of activations and of activation mass are on copy-phase v inputs; 91% of mass is in the copy phase). It fires on only about 1.6% of such steps, so precision is very low. The firing subset leans toward later recall positions (recall_idx 3-5, longer sequences L=9), outputs d/c/t/p and previous inputs m/1/0, but none of these conditions gets precision above about 8%. Magnitude is fairly flat (median 0.12, max 0.23). The largest activations are mid-to-late copy-phase v inputs. Residual activations (15%) are scattered on other tokens (d, x, b, <DEL>) near the end of the original phase or in the copy phase. It does not fire at t<4, on original-phase v, or on correct-copy failures.
